I added `--since DATE` to `scripts/export.py`. It takes `YYYY-MM-DD`, and a bad value is rejected with a usage error (exit 2).

I only ran it against staging with `--dry-run`. A stored hazard note says `EXPORT_BUCKET` in staging points at the production bucket, so a real run would overwrite the prod reports. The dry run printed `exporting staging to ledgerline-exports-dev (dry_run=True, since=2026-09-01)`. The bucket shown is the dev default because `EXPORT_BUCKET` isn't set in my shell, so it says nothing about what staging uses.

The script currently only prints its settings and doesn't export anything yet. `--since` is parsed and shown in that output but doesn't filter anything. Filtering will need to go in once the export logic exists.

I didn't save any new memories; the hazard note already covers the one durable thing that came up.
